source.note: Structure, density, and hierarchy are derived from a full-page screenshot of handhold.io that the user supplied; every value below is Glidda's own, per AGENTS.md §5.3. Taken from the reference: a white page with a single tinted surface tone, monochrome page chrome, colour confined to feature panels, a two-step display scale, low density, black pill buttons, faint hairlines. Not taken: their greige #F2F1ED, their pure #000000, their licensed bureauSerif display face, their #2B8BFF accent, or their amber/mint/peach wash trio. An earlier extraction run against the live site was rejected — artifacts kept at .extract-design-system/ as a record of what was checked.

ink.role: All text, all solid buttons, the travelled length of the rail. Not pure black.

surface.role: Panels, cards, the announcement bar, inset blocks.

rail.role: Hairlines and the untravelled length of the rail. Never text — see rail-muted.

signal.role: The Answers route wash only. No longer a page accent — the page chrome carries no colour at all. Never text.

paper.role: Inputs, floating chips, the Ask bar. Reads as white on a tinted panel.

wash.note: The only form in which a route hue is ever painted. Feature panels only.

rail-muted.role: The only token permitted for muted body text. Authored, not mixed: --rail is now the hairline tone, so mixing from it lands nowhere useful.

rail-hairline.role: Every hairline on the page. The tone is already the hairline — no 40% mix.

rail-subtle.role: Secondary pill hover fill. Stepped down from --surface toward --ink, not up from --rail: under this palette a mix from --rail resolves lighter than --surface and would invert the hover.

display.role: Hero, section headlines, panel headings, pull-quotes, wordmarks. Never below --text-panel — a 300-weight serif is not a body face.

utility.role: Eyebrows, station labels, stat labels, data chips. Nothing else.

scale.note: Two display steps. --text-headline carries section headlines, feature headlines, FAQ questions, and card headings alike; --text-panel is only for small headings inside vignettes and capability cards.

radius.note: Four values, nothing between them. Glidda surfaces use these only.

ask.note: The only shadow in the system. The Ask bar, and nothing else.

motion.note: CSS-layer micro-interactions only. Everything sequenced or scroll-linked is GSAP (§7).
